title: Design System: Learning lab and local player

body.purpose: Recurring empty-state instructions and Settings copy; not a lab type override.

mono.purpose: Filename rows, unavailable metadata and visual-state copy; line boxes remain component-specific.

meta.purpose: Row metadata and consumed-time values; numeric values are tabular.

state.purpose: Departure Mono phase labels; not decorative eyebrows.

shadows.name: flat-theme
shadows.purpose: All source shadow-scale steps resolve to no resting shadow. Focus rings remain interaction feedback.

motion.name: volume-fade
motion.purpose: Base UI's live opaque Volume surface only; never a native snapshot owner.

motion.name: duration-exit
motion.purpose: Library/Settings disclosure exit: ease-in, reverse fade, transparent terminal fill.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: Disclosure entry: ease-out after the exit duration.

motion.name: duration-move
motion.purpose: Native ViewTransition group timing, not transport or clock updates. Reduced motion zeroes native duration and delay and removes control transitions.

components.name: Ghost utility button
components.description: Transport utility appearance with the actual regular Phosphor Volume icon. Base UI supplies behavior in the app.

components.name: Outline session action
components.description: Settings and empty-state action, with the player's minimum interaction height.

components.name: Secondary playback button
components.description: Central playback face; narrow geometry includes the source's invisible target extension. Sample does not start audio.

components.name: Appearance choices
components.description: Settings' System/Light/Dark group. Pressed state is shown; application state and Base UI keyboard behavior are not reimplemented.

components.name: Player surface and identity
components.description: Source surface/identity excerpt, not a second full player. Identity geometry stays local to this component.
components.html:
Choose your music

Local files. This session only.

Open local WAV or MP3 files.

components.name: Playback-only selected row
components.description: Selected unprepared filename row with an independent Play target. Real File identity and playback are app-owned.

components.name: Source waveform pending rail
components.description: Pending/unavailable native seek appearance only; no synthetic waveform. The production SeekBar overlays actual Rust source min/max bins after completion, with separate consumed and preview cursors. It owns source-frame gestures and acknowledged commit; this sample has no media clock or source PCM.
components.html: <input class="ds-seek" aria-label="Position" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0" />

components.name: Centered playback transport
components.description: Previous/Play/Next appearance excerpt. Utilities sit in independent side columns in the full player; no audio or queue behavior exists in this sample.

narrative.overview:
For `/player.html`, this is the user-pinned [#21 interactive prototype](docs/2026-09-13-wave-player-prototype.md), not a generated seed or a new visual world. Its compact, square listening object pairs restrained surfaces with precise identity, honest media state and persistent transport. #22 replaces the historical demo composition only; it does not redesign the lab.

KKB is a technical and creative workshop. The lab should make its work inspectable, using precise
labels, visible state and useful controls. Typography, symbol meaning and information hierarchy
stay stable across light and dark modes. Theme changes come through semantic tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Paired warm neutral modes, ruled divisions and flat resting surfaces.
Inter identity and instructions, TX-02 technical values, player-only Departure Mono states.
A centered player with an adjacent or internal library, never displaced transport.
Honest unavailable media, explicit state and keyboard-reachable controls.

rules.name: The Paired Modes Rule
rules.body: Change semantic pairs, not typography, symbol meaning or control placement, when changing appearance.

rules.name: The Technical Type Rule
rules.body: Use mono for filename rows and values, Inter for the identity heading, instructions and controls, and short player state text rather than decorative eyebrows.

rules.name: The Stationary Transport Rule
rules.body: Library disclosure changes the companion or visual region only; identity, navigation and transport remain available and the actual playback owner survives browsing, theme and viewport changes.

rules.name: The Single Disclosure Owner Rule
rules.body: Base UI alone owns Volume's live mount/fade. React 19.3 stable ViewTransition owns appropriate library and Settings disclosures, not transport, clocks, selection or theme updates.

rules.name: The Honest Media Rule
rules.body: Unavailable media is explicit; never portray invented artwork, metadata, elapsed time or decorative bars as actual source analysis.

dos: **Do** keep semantic color pairs and typography roles stable across modes.
**Do** preserve stationary player transport and the lab's independent instrument composition.
**Do** keep selection, current playback, focus and errors explicit beyond color or hover alone.
**Do** retain real fonts, regular SVG icons, honest media states and source-linked evidence.
donts: **Don't** promote prototype study imagery, synthetic signals or dead future controls into the current player.
**Don't** turn functional state labels into decorative eyebrows or invent a global display scale.
**Don't** add ambient shadows, gradients or a second animation owner to the approved player.
**Don't** treat muted Chromium evidence or sidecar samples as listening, device or accessibility certification.
